answer: Stop sybils with a mesa velvet haven: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa haven. Each cycle it hangs a velvet veil at its gate; verifiers lift the veil and match its weave, voiding a haven whose veil is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 havens at 16x cost each: each veil fits one mesa haven and one velvet weave, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents veil once and keep rights.
